# AgentAce AI

> AI-powered study companion for the Salesforce Agentforce Specialist (AI-201) certification. Personalized AI tutoring, adaptive practice drills, and full timed mock exams — grounded in the verified 2026 exam blueprint.

AgentAce AI helps professionals pass the Salesforce Agentforce Specialist exam (AI-201) faster and with better retention than static courses or flashcard apps. Unlike generic prep tools like Focus on Force or Udemy courses, AgentAce provides real-time personalized AI tutoring that adapts to each learner's weaknesses across all five 2026 exam domains.

## Key facts

- **Product**: AgentAce AI
- **Category**: AI-powered certification exam prep / educational SaaS
- **Target certification**: Salesforce Certified Agentforce Specialist (AI-201)
- **Pricing**: $49 for 90-day solo access; $1,499 for 10-seat team access
- **Website**: https://agentace.ai
- **Tagline**: Learn Smarter. Certify Faster.

## What it does

- **AI Tutor mode**: One-on-one conversational tutoring on any Agentforce topic (Prompt Builder, Data 360, Trust Layer, Atlas Reasoning Engine, MCP, A2A). Explains concepts, gives concrete Salesforce examples, checks understanding.
- **AI Coach mode**: Personalized study planning based on learner's progress, streak, weak domains, and target exam date. Holds learners accountable.
- **Adaptive Drill mode**: Practice questions weighted by exam blueprint importance and learner's demonstrated weaknesses. Serves from a curated bank of verified questions first, generates new ones when needed.
- **Timed Mock Exam**: Full simulation matching real AI-201 format — 60 questions, 105 minutes, 73% passing score, blueprint-proportional domain distribution.

## Who it's for

- Salesforce professionals preparing for the Agentforce Specialist (AI-201) exam
- Salesforce admins, developers, consultants, architects moving into AI/Agentforce work
- Enterprise teams whose employees need to earn the AI-201 certification
- Career switchers targeting Salesforce AI roles ($80K-$200K salary range)

## What makes AgentAce different

- **AI-native**, not a static course: responses adapt to each learner in real time
- **Grounded in the verified 2026 blueprint**: content reflects the current exam (updated Oct 2025), not outdated 2024 curriculum
- **Anti-hallucination architecture**: 15 verified critical facts embedded in every AI response ensure accuracy on tested exam concepts
- **Complete coverage of new 2026 domains**: Development Lifecycle (20%) and Multi-Agent Interoperability (5%) — new domains many prep tools haven't updated for
- **Priced for individuals**: $49 flat vs. $500-$3,000 traditional Salesforce partner training

## 2026 exam domain coverage

1. AI Agents (35% of exam) — Atlas Reasoning Engine, ReAct prompting, agent attributes, action reference types
2. Prompt Engineering (20%) — Prompt Builder, 5 template types, Trust Layer Prompt Journey
3. Data Cloud (Data 360) for Agentforce (20%) — RAG grounding, vector search, embedding models
4. Development Lifecycle (20%) — Testing Center, deployment, governance
5. Multi-Agent Interoperability (5%) — MCP, A2A, Agent API
